title: Letter from Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy to Abraham Mendelssohn-Bartholdy, 1829-05-08
subject: Concerts–England–London; Moscheles, Ignaz, 1794-1870; Sontag, Henriette, 1806-1854; Malibran, Maria, 1808-1836
descrption: Mendelssohn reports to his family about his time in London. A plaster cast was made of his head, he attended a concert where Moscheles performed and met the singers Henriette Sontag and Maria Malibran.
creator: Mendelssohn-Bartholdy, Felix, 1809-1847
source: New York Public Library, Music Division

title: Letter from Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy to Lea Mendelssohn-Bartholdy and Fanny Mendelssohn Hensel, 1829-05-19
subject: Music–England–London; Harrowby, Dudley Ryder, Earl of, 1798-1882; David, Ferdinand, 1810-1873;
descrption: Mendelssohn clears up a misunderstanding about missing parts that he requested for performance and tells the family his music will not be heard at the Philharmonic until the next week at the earliest, if at all. He mentions a visit with Lord Sandon. Klingemann's P.S provides a positive report on Felix and mentions that they have no visited with the Dulckens yet, although they are doing well with their new child.
creator: Mendelssohn-Bartholdy, Felix, 1809-1847; Klingemann, Karl, 1798-1862
source: New York Public Library, Music Division
